# Pranav Dulepet

Website: https://pranavdulepet.github.io/
Updated: 2026-03-12

Summary:
Pranav Dulepet is a Johns Hopkins MSE Computer Science student and AI researcher building reliable human-AI collaborative systems across research, evaluation, and user-facing products.

Current roles:
- AI Research Intern at DataTecnica, building AI agents for biomedical research and a multi-turn benchmark for the biomedical domain.
- M.S.E. in Computer Science (Human Language Technology) at Johns Hopkins University.

Background:
- B.S. (Honors) in Computer Science from the University of Maryland.
- Previous internships at Apple, Amazon, Fidelity Investments, Capital One, and Evozyne.

Research interests:
- Human-AI collaborative systems
- Large language models
- LLM reliability and evaluation
- NLP and biomedical NLP
- AI agents
- Benchmarking
- AI governance and policy
